title:
Sector Rotation
Is Accelerating
subtitle: Where institutional capital is flowing in Q1 2026

slides.heading: What's Happening
paragraphs: Institutional capital is rotating out of crowded AI software plays and into infrastructure bottleneck names.
Power grid, nuclear, and data center REIT stocks are seeing the strongest 13F accumulation since Q3 2024.
The shift accelerated after Anthropic's Cowork launch repriced SaaS workflow tools — investors want picks-and-shovels, not the software being disrupted.
slides.callout: Follow the infrastructure. When AI eats software, the builders of AI infrastructure are the winners.

items.title: Infrastructure is the new growth trade.
items.body: Every AI model needs power, cooling, and connectivity. The bottleneck plays have years of runway.

items.title: Don't fight the flow.
items.body: When 13F filings show institutional accumulation shifting, retail should pay attention — not fight the trend.

items.title: Selectivity is the edge.
items.body: 1,817 stocks scanned, 3 survived. The system's value isn't finding winners — it's avoiding the 99.8% that don't qualify.
